title: Component polish: fix ComboBox hitTest off-by-one + arrow toggle + extraTextFields signature
description: Three static-analysis findings in packages/swf/src/compiler/components.ts (the v2 component runtime, tasks 1231-1235), all confirmed by code reading: (1) HIGH — ComboBox onMouseDown hitTest is off-by-one (~lines 872-887): 'bottom = _y + __rowTop + (open ? items*rowHeight : 0)' then 'my <= bottom + rowHeight' adds a phantom extra row, so a CLOSED ComboBox accepts clicks two rows down and an OPEN one accepts a phantom row below the last item. Fix: drop the trailing '+ this.__rowHeight' so the clickable area matches the visible rows (closed = 1 row; open = 1 + N rows). (2) LOW — ControlSpec.extraTextFields is declared (w,h) but List/ComboBox impls are (w)=>... ignoring height; the call site passes both. Make the signature consistent (either mark height optional in the interface or accept it). (3) MINOR — ComboBox arrow_mk overlay is never toggled; hide/flip arrow_mk._visible in __setOpen for open/closed visual feedback. VERIFY each against the current code first. Add/extend tests: a structural or Ruffle-oracle assertion for the corrected ComboBox hit boundary (e.g. a click just below the collapsed row does NOT open it; an open-dropdown click below the last item does NOT select a phantom). Build+tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable); update docs/13 if behavior noted. Scope: components.ts + component-place.test.ts / component-oracle.spec.ts.
